description: This file is a JavaScript source script used for generating C# API interface code from API documentation. It processes API definitions, types, enums, and generates corresponding C# classes, interfaces, and enums, including handling of documentation and type translation.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Generates a C# code file with documentation and class/interface/enum definitions based on provided specifications.

methods.name: renderClass
methods.description: Renders a C# interface class from a documentation class object, including members and documentation.

methods.name: renderModelType
methods.description: Generates a C# class from a documentation type, handling properties and nested types.

methods.name: renderEnum
methods.description: Creates a C# enum from a list of string literals.

methods.name: renderOptionType
methods.description: Generates a C# class for API options based on documentation type properties.

methods.name: toArgumentName
methods.description: Converts parameter names to valid C# argument names, prefixing with '@' if needed.

methods.name: toMemberName
methods.description: Converts member or parameter names to C#-friendly property or method names, handling async suffixes.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to TitleCase.

methods.name: renderConstructors
methods.description: Creates constructor overloads for C# classes.

methods.name: renderMemberDoc
methods.description: Renders documentation comments for class members.

methods.name: renderMember
methods.description: Renders class members (properties, methods, events) with documentation and attributes.

methods.name: getPropertyOverloads
methods.description: Generates property overloads for different JSON representations.

methods.name: generateNameDefault
methods.description: Generates default property or type names based on documentation types and context.

methods.name: generateEnumNameIfApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a type should be generated as an enum based on its union values.

methods.name: renderMethod
methods.description: Renders a method signature with parameters, async handling, and documentation.

methods.name: translateType
methods.description: Translates documentation types into C# type strings, handling generics, arrays, objects, and special cases.

methods.name: registerModelType
methods.description: Registers a type in the model types map if it is a custom type.

methods.name: printArgDoc
methods.description: Outputs XML documentation comments for method parameters.

methods.name: toAsync
methods.description: Appends 'Async' suffix to method names if needed.

methods.name: rewriteSuggestedOptionsName
methods.description: Rewrites certain suggested option type names to a common type name.
